remote_worker_probe.method: read-only HTTP status probe from the installed worker host with the collector's User-Agent

interpretation: The BLS monthly calendar returned HTTP 403 both through the local production-style collector and from the installed worker host with the collector's User-Agent. It must not be represented as a successfully collected source. The September BLS page visibly contains the October 2 employment entry in an independent web view; this date's omission cannot be attributed solely to the current-month URL choice.
effects: No source content was written into a saved historical edition. No Slack or operating database action occurred.
